title: Jinhsi/Voicelines
wikitext:
{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Jinhsi |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Welcome to {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}}, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = The bustling city of {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}} is a product of every blooming flower, sturdy brickwork, and occupied home. With every new visitor, the city gains new life. Among them, you are truly one of a kind... No, I am not simply repeating what our {{Extra Effect|Sentinel|Sentinel|Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.}} has said. These words come from my heart as well. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = An old proverb states, "When a great mind emerges, even the sea will part and the mountains will tremble." It speaks to the transformative power of extraordinary individuals... With your presence in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}, I believe great changes will come in due time. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = I used to be quite curious about your background. However, I've come to realize that one's actions hold more weight than their past. Your past may shape you, but it is your present deeds that truly define you. Having witnessed everything you have done for {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}, I cannot help but notice the mysterious connections between them... Perhaps there is something deeper behind your arrival in Jinzhou. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = Walking alone may lead to a faster pace, but a group can cover greater distances.
Moving forward, I will stand by my companions… and I will stand by you as we face whatever the future holds, together. |vo_02_01_title = Jinhsi's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Have you been to the Jinzhou Theater? It's a place of endless joy and laughter, especially when a show concludes on a happy note. I've always cherished that sight, which is why I want to ensure everyone finds their own happy ending. |vo_02_02_title = Jinhsi's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Hmm... When faced with challenges, I am driven by a sense of purpose to find solutions instead of succumbing to worry. The feeling of worry or frustration rarely crosses my mind nowadays. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = If you haven't yet, I highly recommend visiting {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}'s morning market. The breakfast stall vendor sells the most delicious Loong Buns topped with plump red dates. As they steam, their sweet aroma envelops the air. They are truly a delight. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}} once suffered from severe food shortages because of the {{Extra Effect|Lament|Lament|The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.}} crisis. As someone who lived through that difficult time, I've learned to understand that food is not something to be taken lightly. Every morsel is a gift from Mother Nature as are those who work tirelessly to cultivate it... Personally, I have no dislikes when it comes to food, except for wasteful extravagance or exorbitant prices. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = People prayed to the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} not out of weakness, but because they had no other recourse. As leader, I will guide my people towards a future where humanity takes control of our own destiny. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = As a child, I had vivid dreams, some of them turning into nightmares. I would find myself lost at sea, fighting against the crashing waves and tangled seaweed. But each time, I managed to hold onto a piece of driftwood and make it back to shore. And when I woke up, I would find something in my hand… Yes, it was this shiny piece of scale. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = The snows of Mt. Firmament... I still vaguely remember how the snowflakes there danced in their own whimsical ways. One moment they were hovering in the air, and the next moment they flew upwards into the sky, twirling around the tree branches... Before long, everything was coated in a shimmering blanket of white. In {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}, the snow brings a sense of peaceful togetherness. Strangers become friends as they brush off each other's shoulders and build snowmen together... Whether the snow is light or heavy, I pray to always protect these precious moments of pure tranquility. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Changli]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Changli.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend. |vo_04_01_mention = Changli |vo_04_02_title = About [[Sanhua]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Sanhua.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Amidst my busy days, meals can easily slip my mind. Before I knew it, it would be well past the time for another meal. But like a blessing, Sanhua would always appear with a plate of delicious Loong Buns, filled with exactly what I was craving. I am in awe… How does she know every time? |vo_04_02_mention = Sanhua |vo_04_03_title = About [[Taoqi]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Taoqi.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable. |vo_04_03_mention = Taoqi |vo_04_04_title = About [[Jiyan]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Jiyan.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = "Qingloong rise, monsters gone"... Every child in Jinzhou knows this nursery rhyme by heart. My faith rests with Jiyan, for with his protection the {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discords|Tacet Discord|Tacet Discords, beings created by the Waveworn Phenomena bearing "Tacet Cores", are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms, which feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolution. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.}} will never breach our borders. |vo_04_04_mention = Jiyan |vo_04_05_title = About [[Rover]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Rover.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes. |vo_04_05_mention = Rover |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = After much contemplation, I have decided that a handmade gift will better express my feelings than any expensive store-bought present. Every day since learning of your birthday, I have devoted time to crafting a Loong lantern from materials I've handpicked. Fortunately, I've finished it in time. If you could find time in your busy schedule, please join me at the City Hall to fly this lantern together. It is a beloved tradition in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}} to make a wish upon a soaring lantern on one's birthday, and it is said that the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} will bestow blessings for the year ahead. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = (Hmm...) |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = (Contemplating) |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = May I pray for anything specific for you? It would be my honor… I'm sure your wishes will come true. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = I am Jinhsi, the {{Extra Effect|Magistrate of Jinzhou|Magistrate of Jinzhou|The head governor of Jinzhou.
In Huanglong, when a Magistrate takes office, they adopt the region's name as their own. For example, Jinhsi was originally named Hsi but changed her name to Jinhsi after becoming the Magistrate of Jinzhou.}}. My role holds great power and duty. I vow to serve my people with diligence and bring prosperity to our land. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = As the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} foretold, you and I were meant to cross paths. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Let's go together. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Learning through experience. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = I am here to assist. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = No one is born good at anything. As the {{Extra Effect|Magistrate of Jinzhou}}, I must constantly learn and improve. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = As the new {{Extra Effect|Magistrate|Magistrate|The Magistrate is a governing official who oversees one of the major regions within Huanglong.}}, I initially worried about my lack of ability to protect my people. But soon, I realized that dwelling on self-doubt only hindered my progress, so I trained harder. With each session, my strengths grew. It is an honor to serve and defend my people. I'll always strive to improve as their Magistrate. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Thank you for your guidance. I have seen growth in my strength and leadership abilities, and it seems you have taught me more than just swordsmanship; you've taught me valuable life lessons. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = I am aware that I have rather peculiar frequencies. It is rare for me to encounter someone whose vibrations align with mine so perfectly... Could it be that you also share a mysterious connection with our {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}? I do hope so, as that would make me feel… even closer to you. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = As I get to know you better, I can't help but notice the similarities between us. Our frequencies, powers, and even purposes seem to align. Defending {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}} is my duty, and now I sense a deep connection between you and this land… I once believed that mankind should control our own destiny, but my meeting with you has shown me the power of fate. I am grateful for its hand in bringing you into my life. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Jinhsi |language = en |heavy_1_tx = The hour of hope. |heavy_2_tx = Shine forevermore. |heavy_3_tx = The time is nigh. |heavy_4_tx = Divine Loong's blessing. |aerial_1_tx = Fallen star. |aerial_2_tx = Beckoning light. |resskill_1_tx = Moment of awakening. |resskill_2_tx = Thawing harmony. |resskill_3_tx = Embrace the change. |resskill_4_tx = Our lights shine through. |resskill_5_tx = Florescent Shadows. |resskill_6_tx = Bask in starlight. |resskill_7_tx = Take flight! |resskill_8_tx = The sky beckons! |resskill_9_tx = Strike fast! |resskill_10_tx = Thus it ends! |resskill_11_tx = Evil be cleansed! |resskill_12_tx = Sacred light! |resliberation_1_tx = Thunder guide us! |resliberation_2_tx = Heaven ordains.
